text: Love it. Amber is great. Drinks are great and great price. Pork rinds are one of a kind...come out cracking. Catfish nuggets fantastic. Creamed spinach was over salted but they replaced with a different side for us. Staff is great and accommodating.

I found this restaurant/bar on Yelp and decided to give it a try. Boy was I in for a treat. I ordered the street corn, a blood orange IPA and No Bull Beyond Burger with fries. The street corn was the best I've ever had. The burger and fries were great. The beer was good too. I can't wait to come back.
Very thirsty, my urine was yellow before coming here. Waited 57 minutes for a refill. Very dehydrated, my pee is becoming solid. Happy about free pie tho.

The food is great and we have been supporting this place since it is locally owned and operated. Truly, we order from here 2-4 times a month. However, tonight I was disappointed in the pick up process and the portion of queso we received. There were three people in front of me waiting to pick up their orders, but no one but the cooks were handing out the orders that were sitting there. Only when a cook had time to turn around and pay attention, did he start handing out orders that were sitting there.  You need a better system CT! Also, they skimped big time on the amount of queso we got in the regular size! Enough for one person, not 2 to enjoy. Nothing like feeling ripped off when you get home to see your order. We'll keep ordering, but will definitely check my order before leaving the store.

Go to taco place when I'm in the area.  Can't go wrong with anything on the menu.  They are generous with the portions and everything is always super fresh.  I usually call in my order before I go there.  It's off the 301 next to the produce stand.  It's easier to park in the Sam's club parking lot and walk through the produce stand.  They also have great produce if you happen to need any.

Egg was awesome! My husband and I work completely different schedules and rarely get a day off together, and unfortunately weekdays are usually when they happen... in the interest of supporting local, we hopped online and searched Tuesday Brunch and this is where we landed...

We walked in, at like 1230 and the bartender (who I assume is..) the owner, handed us 2 menus, and asked us to sit wherever. They have a space that would otherwise fit a large number of people if there isn't a global pandemic happening... but the whole place is clean and well organized, and socially distanced! 

There's a pretty great "brunch" drink menu available, and it seems that their coffee/tea/beverage menu was pretty legit as well. We had the espresso martini, that complemented both our dishes flawlessly! 

The food menu is very southwest/Mexican, and has a variety of tastes available... I had cornbread Benedict with pork belly, and the hubs had baby back ribs with beans and green chilies, and eggs in a delicious looking sauce! Pics (of drinks and MY food below ). The ribs were tender as could be, and I've never had a better cut of pork belly prepared better! We left in a serious food coma, and will be happy to return again very soon!

Amazing as always! We finally got to take my in-laws after years of telling them about the "world famous" wings! Finally my FIL got to try them and agreed! We love that this location is family friendly so we can visit more often with our two year old as well! 

Pretzel crusted fried pickles are a MUST and hermanaki boneless are the way to go (with a side of fries). Seriously, If you haven't tried this place out, what are you waiting for???

Great view, way overpriced.  Has a food truck feel for prices that should be in an upscale restaurant.  This trend is becoming more and more common, but I don't have to like it.  When my wife and I visited, we just kept walking a little further to Columbia and got some decent priced food.

Went a couple of times before the pandemic. I waited about 5-10 mins on both times which was okay. There are very limited tables/seats to dine in so the staff defaultly packs your order in a bag. Their packaging is way too excessive, plastic bags here and there. On both visits, there were items that were incorrect or missing. It got sorted out when i went to the cashier but could be avoided altogether considering they have a lot of staff checking the orders before it gets to you. I suggest you check your order before you head out if you are not dining in.

Chickenjoy as expected was juicy and crispy and just how it tasted in the philippines. Spaghetti, peach mango pie and palabok was ok. Pineapple juice too sweet, like full of sugar. Gravy complimented the crispy skin of chickenjoy.

Some people said the food is overpriced. I think it is just about right. Every chicken fastfood outlet has their distinctive taste and every person has their personal preferences so i won't compare this to popeye's or kfc. 

Will i be back? Definitely but will wait for the kingsway branch to be open. South side branch is too far.

If you're looking for healthy delicious food with organic, vegan, and gluten-free options, this is your place. If none of these sound familiar or interesting to you, this is still your place. That's how much I love the food and experience at Craft Kafe. 
 
Based on my friend's last experience here, she recommended that we go here for brunch. We came hungry and slightly indecisive so naturally we ordered a few things. She ordered the mediterranean toast and breakfast pizza with a side of coffee. I ordered a make your own omelette, avocado toast and some amazing orange blossom iced tea. Oh yeah, I can't forget the apple baked goody I ordered to go.  My gigantic omelette came with gluten-free bread and a side of breakfast potatoes. The two of us sat outside feasting on enough plates that look as if four people were eating. I have no regrets... everything was amazingly delicious. I left happy and stuffed!!

You can sit inside or out side. There is an outside walk up window to order coffee. The outside seating area is fur baby friendly. 

I will definitely be back next time I visit Saint Pete! And if the owners are reading this, Please build one in Orlando, Florida

Tuesday is Mother Daughter time.  Decided we would overcome our Covid fear and eat out.  We walked in and they were busy, waited a good ten minutes before being asked about being seated.  Sat in a booth right next to other people back to back. I'm a frontline worker and that made me a tad nervous.  Florida rules, my choice.  Should have ate outside.  Ordered the 2 for $22 and a Strawberry Margarita (on special!).  Our meal a Cheeseburger with tots, Bourbon Chicken with steamed Broccoli and mashed potatoes, and the salad bar.  Who doesn't love this salad bar!!?  Unfortunately our appetizer pretzels came out charcoal the first time (picture is the second try, much better).  Cheeseburger was good, slightly leaning towards rare more than medium rare.  The bourbon chicken was overcooked and dry, couldn't eat most of the chicken because it was like straw.  When asked by cashier how the meal was, we let him know and the manager and GM came out and apologized.  They offered to comp the meal, but I pay for my meal, plus service was great!  Kudos to the staff and management, we'll be back to try again because of service.  I did have a craving for Dessert Chocolate Lava cake, they comped it, thanks.

In a nutshell - nothing to write home about. Food was fine, service subpar, location great, price average. 3 of us ordered 3 appetizers and 3 entrees. When  ordering, u asked about peanuts in a dish and was told "it might" have peanuts to which I said I better order something else then. We went on to have Rangoon, chicken satay, spring rolls) and they were all good but nothing special. 2 of them came with peanut sauces or peanut oil and the server did not warn me or offer other sauces and wasn't around for me to ask for another. My green curry was fine, again good but nothing too special. The other 2 dishes we ordered were wide rice noodle dishes with different names, but came out looking and tasting exactly the same. Overall food was fine but wish the server was more accommodating and sensitive to food allergies and checked in with our table after bringing the food.
Alexius was our server and did a great job! Awesome happy hour deals and she was right on top of things. Definitely one of the best places to sit outside and enjoy a few drinks!
Dirty, nasty, and most of all RUDE.  It's a nasty place and the staff sucks.  Hoping to escape with only a mild case of food poisoning.  Pray for us.

Ordered their Chicken Parmesan Fettuccine Feast. Included pasta, Parmesan chicken, family salad with ranch dressing, garlic bread, brownies, and a pint of Vanilla ice cream. Everything was tasty. Food was still hot when I served it at home. The chicken Parmesan was tender and moist and had lots of seasoning and gooey melted cheese on top. The salad had lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, shredded carrots, and onion. Croutons were packaged on the side so they didn't get soggy mixed in with the salad. Plus there was plenty of ranch dressing to go around for everyone to have their own individual serving. Their famous bread was a bit dry but still tasty. On the whole the meal was satisfying and great, however being Italian, I would've preferred a bit more sauce on the fettuccine.
Dessert of their brownies and ice cream was a delicious finish to a great meal. Their brownies are soft and chewy and personally, I could probably eat a whole pan by myself! Five stars plus tonight for a great meal and as always, some of the most helpful, polite, friendly staff for ordering and picking up.

I love this place. The servers are friendly and remember what I order. Reasonable prices, quick takeout - what's not to love?? The Panang is very peanut-y. The green curry is good with bamboo and eggplant. I love both and those are my go to orders. I also enjoy that pad Thai and I had the fresh rolls. I should branch out but I have to drive to get here so usually make go with tried and true favorites.
Great place !! Our sever, Patrick was awesome !! We got the Peyton hamburger and it was delicious. Will definitely go back when we are in town.

Ijji 4 aka Ijji Korea is a favorite of both my husband (an unregenerate carnivore) and myself (less carniverous, but still likes good meat).  If you haven't ever eaten at a Korean grill before, recommended.  

This type of restaurant provides you with a variety of meats that you cook over a grill in the middle of your table.  The spicy pork and the chicken tenders are my favorites, but there are a bunch of choices of both meat and seafood.  There's also a selection of good sides (included with the "all you can eat" meals), and a good menu of appetizers.  The meal isn't cheap, but is less expensive than many places that aren't nearly as good.

I am a fan of Bryn and Dane's! It is a casual place with a lovely botanical atmosphere. It is a very vegan and vegetarian friendly place. The order kiosks are nice and convenient; in all the times that I've been there I've never had to wait to order. The food does take a while to come out, though. But it is comforting that the kitchen area is pretty open so you can see them preparing your food. I have had the sweet potato fries many times and they are delicious, but the most recent time they were still slightly frozen (hot on the outside and cold on the inside.) I don't have a problem with them using fries that are frozen, but I expect them to be heated thoroughly, especially if they take a while to come out.

I'm a big fan of Thai curries and I have to say this is one of the best Massaman curries I have had and the delicious and unusual addition of a meaty tender lamb shank is genius! Service was attentive and friendly. Beautiful dining room with water feature in the center.

This Benihana's is the BEST in the nation. The staff is friendly and welcoming. Ask for Juan as your chef-his show and food cooking finesse is outstanding. 
Atmosphere
Friendly and more open as compared to others.
Even though full tables, not too loud. 
Food
Generous servings of salad and soup. The other group at our table had alot of food allergies but Juan accommodated them all expertly. The fried veggie rice is extra but worth it. My go to preference is the salmon-love the avocado sauce. The noodles are delicious! The other group ordered calamari-reported that it was superb. Note-it is square not rings. 
Service
Unmatched! If you are going for the best experience ever-go here!! ALL of the staff were on-hand to sing and tambourine the birthday song also in Japanese! 
Summary
Only go to this Benihana's for the best dining experience ever. Three cheers to mamagement and staff!
This is a great place for fresh food served with a smile. I had a Fruity Fran on a croissant with the Tomato Bisque soup! Delicious. Will go again.
If you are looking for a less busy breakfast establishment in NOLA, then this place is an idea. The food was fine overall.

We went hungry, we liked the nice clean facility and wait staff.  The Portobello mushrooms were amazingly flavorful and delicious.  The avocado bruschetta was not flavorful.  The Reuben was good, the jackfruit was not flavorful but my husband mixed it with the rice and beans and said it was much better.  The cheese cake alone was okay but then we mixed the two flavors and it was great.  We mixed mocha and pistachio.  The tea and meal was outrageously expensive but good.

Love love love brunch at LouVino! I frequent the Mass Ave location and the vibe is always great. It's one of my favorite places for mimosas and wine flights. They're open during brunch and dinner but not in between. I definitely recommend making a reservation, it gets pretty packed on the weekends.

Im not sure why I haven't written a review for this place because I come here at least once a week/every other week. This is located in a plaza with other restaurants and supermarket nearby. There is parking but it may get busy especially on the weekends - it's packed and can be hard to find parking. 

What I really love about this place is how fast the service is. If you know what you want, the server will get your order in and within 5-10 mins, your food will be served. They serve complimentary hot tea if you'd like. And sometimes I would ask for green onions/hot oil on the side for that extra richness for the broth.  

Hands down, my favorite and my go-to pho spot. It is cash only, which is the only downside but they do have a Atm inside.
Hands down the best sushi I have ever had. Their sushi size is a perfect and everything tastes amazing.

We found this gem on Yelp! The food is amazing and the hospitality was great. If you want some bomb breakfast burritos you found your spot  
We loved it so much we will be back again tomorrow morning.
Excellent! Just make sure to clean door handles often and have hand sanitizer available to the public.

Tried it again and surely won't be anything wrong this time! Wrong it was. Grits at 9am was like water and not even hot. How many times do I fool myself and go back!!!! The woman cleaning the table said are you suppose to be at this table??? I said yes the lady in front sent us over here. Then she said OK!!!! Friendly right? One more time like I am not smart but tried again since I live so close. We waited in lobby for awhile and saw many booths available. They told one man he couldn't get one but we sat down in one. No one came by or said anything for about 15 min. The manager came over and said a waitress would work her way to us soon. There were 3 waitresses and no one showed up so he brought us water but never asked what we wanted to eat or drink. Then I saw a waitress wait on a couple who came in abut 10 min after we sat down, We left!!!!!!!!!!  Isn't that crazy folks!!! For some reason they can't get this place together. 20 minutes and no waitress. Not good!

Had the catfish platter, boyfriend had the mixed fried platter. Meal was good, however it didn't have much of a Louisiana taste. I expected Creole and Cajun flavors but the meal was good. Service was good. Food came out rather quickly.

Another excellent meal at Effie's. We had a large party. The staff was pleasant & accommodating to everyone. We loved the calamari, appetizer plater. Everyone also enjoyed our meals. In the world of eating salmon, this one is extra delicious! Most tasty moussaka. 2 different lamb dishes, shrimp & rice, pasta. The cheese blintz to finish hit the spot. Byob that always satisfies the belly!!

This restaurant has proven to be everything I needed and more on bourbon street!! If you come here definitely get the red fish, truly incredible! Come and request your server to be Asheigh she will blow your mind with fast service with the best support, love, and compassion you never knew you needed. Looking for exquisite seafood at a convenient location with servers that will boost your self esteem?? Then come on over to Red Fish Grill.

Lindo Mexico has been my south side hole-in-the-wall go to for years. Last week I took my mom for lunch, and was happy to return. The service is fast and food is reliably good. Plus there's always a good cheap lunch special (like my Arroz con Pollo, which was $2 off through February). 

Covid precautions were good but staff tended to take off mask when off. Unfortunately, they did so and hung out right behind out table. Otherwise they'd get 5 stars.
good spot. I liked the enchiladas I got. very chill and laid-back dining experience.

LOVE the Parkshore Grill. Stumbled along this amazing place during a lunch break when I was traveling for work. I always sit at the bar & ask the bartender for suggestions. I picked 2 starters the crab cake & lobster toast. They were both amazing but I plan on going back tomorrow during my lunch to get the lobster toast one more time! Honestly I'll probably get both again but the toast was my favorite.
Thunderbird pizza has the best buffalo chicken pizza on the planet. Also the staff is always very friendly despite how busy they are!

Wow!! Ordered the Taco Tuesday special (3 tacos, chips, salsa) for $9.00. Thai chicken was super. Hubby ordered the tuna tacos. They were stuffed with tons of seared chunks of tuna. Very impressed, can't wait for Tuesday to roll around again!!

Against my better judgement I revisited this store. I should have known better by now, but I really wanted some cajun rice.

I found a bone in my boneless tender. A bone. In a boneless tender. Not gristle or a tiny fragment, but a bone. The tenders were stale and chewy anyhow without biting down on a hard bone.

This place is disgusting. Rude, nasty, disgusting.

Food was 3 stars but one star for the staff.  Staff really needs to improve their attitude (she yelled at my boyfriend when he asked for water which she should have brought it up anyways!) 

Also soap was watered down which did not do its job! Come on! I will never go back!
Nice quaint coffee & tea shop. A hidden gem. Enjoyed the food and drink. I got the mudslide which is a mix of espresso, hot chocolate and marshmallows. I absolutely love their outside area.

Great food great service 
Homemade sauces are wonderful 
Chips and salsa are always fresh

This place is amazing got tandoori chicken 
Masala fish cooked to perfection 5 star dinning without the five star pricing u great service thank u so much this is my new spot from now on

We placed a rather large order for curbside pickup. It was expensive. The chicken wings were pretty good. The three pizzas were just average, fairly flavorless; frozen Organic pizzas from Sprouts are so much better.  The calamari was terrible--way over done and more breading than calamari. We threw it out after tasting it.  One of the servers we saw was wearing a face shield without a face mask beneath it. CDC does not recommend the use of face shields as a substitute for masks. We will never go back or order from this restaurant.

Called in to order for the first time and service was great! Our dinner plans changed last minute and El Limon made the night awesome. Our order was ready for pickup within 15 minutes. Tried the tacos and tostadas and will come in for more soon!

The husband and I had a nice anniversary dinner here last night. They were able to accommodate us at 5:30pm outside even though we just called to make reservations three hours before. The outdoor area is super cute. It almost feels like I'm dining in someone's fancy backyard. The tables were well distanced even more spread out than CDC regulations require.

The service from our server couldn't have been more friendly. Since it was Saturday, the menu was prix fixed, three courses for $45/pp. we split the Mediterranean Sampler. While it was all good, the roasted veggie dip was our favorite thing on the plate. My husband ordered the Cavatelli & Lamb. It was so good and the lamb was braised well and still very moist. I got the Seafood Paella. The presentation was the best because it came in a tagine pot. The taste was good but I felt like the seafood could have been fresher.

We got the hazelnut gelato for dessert and also received a complementary berry sorbet that they just made fresh. Both were delicious! I would recommend Byrsa for the service and the ambiance.

Me and my father decided to have lunch today at one of his favorite restaurants he's very cheap like me with that being said we decided to dine at this China buffet for $ 7.99 you definitely pay for what you get the food had NO taste on top of that EVERYTHING was cold I started to say something to the manager who is also the owner I realized he was speaking to a young lady who was from the health department I decided to keep my opinion to myself and just eat the food I could see the owner was having a issue so I did not want to bring anymore problems his way if you ever want to grab something to eat and really don't care about the price or the taste then this restaurant is for you.

Came here right on the last day before they close till March with a couple of friends. The staff was friendly and the outdoor dining was reasonably distanced.

The House Smoked Eggs Benedict was pretty decent. The eggs were poached well. According to the waiter the salmon is wet smoked , but it lacks the flavor to not be overpowered by the hollandaise sauce. The hollandaise sauce itself was way too buttery for me. The first thing you taste is butter assaulting yourself tastebuds and it drowns everything else out. 

Overall it wasn't a bad meal, a bit higher priced then what I would like for the flavors I got. It would have been better if they redid the hollandaise and giving salmon having more flavor.
The bacon Mac dog was very good.  Very friendly staff, will definitely go back to support this local small business.

We came here to try their homemade kimchi and left with a few more items than we expected. This is a really tidy and friendly Asian Market that carries a lot of different Asian products from food, snacks, fruits and veggies, drinks and alcohol. The food selection here was quite extensive in addition to their homemade kimchi they also had prepared meats like marinated bulgogi and fresh crab. Their fish prices were competitive to those at the fish market or grocery store. 

All in all their store is really organized and the employees were welcoming and helpful. This will be our new go-to for Asian food and drink. 

As other reviewers have said it is mostly a Korean and Japanese market, so you may not find what you are looking for if you are cooking Chinese.
